authorization: Existing autonomous research authorization and explicit bounded repair after concrete new failure evidence; not a relaxation of independent author equality.
observed_before_correction: Failed full1000 v2 implementation checks and stored trajectories
change: Replace terminal answer measurements from joint-agent forward outputs with separate receiver-only author readouts for each agent/depth; native uses full-model path. Reuse unchanged cached recurrence states. Both common-input sources use explicit same-receiver readouts. Keep message and message-classifier measurements from the recurrence unchanged.
unchanged: Original primary parity weights, six depths and repeated-even-peak shape gate
All1000 original questions, order, labels, tokenizer/config/model/channel
Frozen recurrence dynamics and message encoding/aggregation
Independent six author prediction comparisons and four applicable message-hash comparisons on all1000
Public-reference mismatch reporting separate from within-environment validity
Fixed192 numerical probe with original blocks and BF16 reduction-only change
implementation_requirements: Cached states retain original provenance and exact original example ordering; do not overwrite v2 evidence
All new terminal label predictions equal argmax of captured label logits
Both agents use separate receiver-only batches; changing which agent is read out never changes recurrence
Full1000 new author calls must match six prediction cases and four message hashes; save per-item independent author labels
No statistical analysis on failed corrected validity
Probe recomputes recurrence under changed flag; it must not reuse baseline messages for the intervention

budgets.full_projection_rule: 1.5*(legacy setup + legacy elapsed minus setup minus sum(forwards) +30*1.2*max(last2 receiver forwards))+180; 30=26 agent/depth readouts plus4 common-input readouts. Diagnostic reserve must be<22GiB.
budgets.probe_projection_rule: 1.3*(corrected setup +192/1000*(legacy first13 forwards +corrected terminal forwards +corrected common-input forwards))+120; must be<=1200 seconds. Primary-negative branch need not spend further GPU on the probe.

sensitivity.selection: First original64-question block plus the two previously discrepant original blocks; chosen before full results, partly failure-targeted, not independent confirmation.
sensitivity.interpretation: Tests only this allowed-kernel setting. Equal outputs may mean the backend did not use reduced reductions. It neither establishes full-FP32 robustness nor identifies the H100 difference cause.

robustness_analysis.primary: All1000, no exclusions, original contrast/shape rules unchanged.
robustness_analysis.reference_sensitivity: Report all reference mismatches; secondary recomputation excluding union of discrepant items, plus worst-case mean interval allowing their primary scores anywhere in[-1,1]. Exclusion is outcome-dependent and cannot replace primary analysis.
robustness_analysis.numerical_probe: Compare matched question IDs and exact token rows against full baseline; report every depth label-change rate, paired primary-score changes and descriptive curve/shape changes. A sign or required-shape reversal on the same probe prevents a robustness claim. Do not extrapolate192 to all1000.
robustness_analysis.decision: Full pattern must meet original positive CI and repeated even peaks. Negative main result terminates parity-specific branch without tuning depths. Positive main result remains provisional until sensitivity checks complete; no paper-level causal or scaling claim.

limitations: A validated implementation correction is not a new scientific result.
Batch/layout readout differences do not establish the cause of cross-hardware public-reference mismatches.
Preserve both failed v1/v2 histories; never relabel their validity flags.
